attributes.action: Allow Premier League Football To Play At 3PM On Saturday’s
attributes.additional_details: This Petition is to get rid of the 3pm Blackout for Football matches. People pay money for sky sports & to watch football and for us to not be able to watch a football match just because it is on at 3pm is not fair. I think getting rid of the 3pm blackout would make a lot of people happy
attributes.background: Get rid of the 3pm blackout for football matches. Keep 3pm football matches broadcasting on Sky Sports

rejection.details: Decisions about when to hold and broadcast football matches are a matter for the FA, the Premier League and the Football League, and broadcasters, not the Government or House of Commons.
